name: Ghost Ship Lovers
source:
The story begins when you find a book about pirate in a bookstore. When you come back home you decide to read it before sleeping. 

When you wake up you find yourself in a cell, in the hold of a ship. 

What your doing there? You have no idea.

[From [url=https://thirstycupcake.itch.io/ghost-ship-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你在书店找到一本关于海盗的书时，故事就开始了。当你回到家时，你决定在睡觉前阅读它。

当你醒来时，你发现自己在一间牢房里，在一艘船的货舱里。

你在那里做什么？你不知道。

[来自[url=https://thirstycupcake.itch.io/ghost-ship-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
